headline: LAD @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 4.13 at ARI 5.09, with a projected total of 9.23. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ARI: LAD moved +0.52 runs while ARI moved +2.48, changing the projected margin by -1.97 runs. The projected total climbed +3.00, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -17.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Michael Soroka has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ketel Marte, Andy Pages, Shohei Ohtani, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Tim Tawa because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
